Support Group-Saturday October 6th11:00 AM – 12:00 PM Topic:  Scrapbook Your Weight Loss Journey
Come join us for the support group on Saturday October 6th.  Our special guest will be scrapbook specialist, Linda Langhammer.  Linda will share with you how to record your weight loss journey with the use of pictures and journaling in a very creative way.  There will be a maximum of 15 participants.  So call (513-559-1222) or email (rebecca@thebanddoctor.com) early to reserve your spot.  Each participant is to bring 2-4 pictures to begin their scrapbooking journey.
